prompt: State whether absolute uncertainties or percentage uncertainties are added when determining the uncertainty in a quantity calculated by adding or subtracting two measured values.

response_structure.guidance: State which form of uncertainty is added for addition or subtraction.

hints: Recall the rule: operations involving sums and differences preserve the physical units of uncertainty.
solution: Absolute uncertainties are added when adding or subtracting two measured values.
teacher_walkthrough: Step 1: Identify the operation: addition or subtraction.
Step 2: Apply the rule: sums and differences require adding absolute uncertainties in the same unit.
Step 3: Award 1 mark for absolute uncertainties.
lesson_anchors: Addition and subtraction use absolute uncertainties

abstract_patterns: combining uncertainties in sums, products, quotients, and power relations
provenance.independence_statement: Authored independently based on standard Cambridge AS Physics syllabus rules for combining uncertainties.
